title: Politics of outer space
source: Wikipedia - List of topics in space
description: Public policy concerning the exploration of outer space
executive_summary: Space policy is the political decision-making process for, and application of, public policy of a state regarding spaceflight and uses of outer space, both for civilian and military purposes. International treaties, such as the 1967 Outer Space Treaty, attempt to maximize the peaceful uses of space and restrict the militarization of space.
